title: Envelope-wrap remaining Facial review commands
origin: MT-044 D15a/D15c split: MT-031 envelope-wrapped export only; the other Facial review commands still need durable blocked/degraded/error/succeeded envelopes. D15b reject/hold semantics remains a separate spec/operator decision and is excluded here.

state_recovery.recovery_rule: Resume MT-055 by reading this contract, limiting edits to allowed_paths, using external CARGO_TARGET_DIR under ../Handshake_Artifacts, and keeping validator_verdict PENDING until an official validator changes it.

scope.summary: Extend durable Facial command outcome envelopes from export to session, claim, decision, status, and montage commands, and tidy now-inaccurate docs/comments touched by that same path without changing reject/hold degraded semantics.
base_scope: Extend durable Facial command outcome envelopes from export to session, claim, decision, status, and montage commands, and tidy now-inaccurate docs/comments touched by that same path without changing reject/hold degraded semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Facial session, claim, decision, status, and montage commands return durable outcome envelopes matching the export command shape for blocked/degraded/error/succeeded outcomes.
Each non-succeeded outcome has a stable code, recovery hint, and read-backable receipt where applicable.
Frontend parser/drain logic renders non-succeeded statuses honestly and never hardcodes succeeded.
D15b reject/hold-only success-vs-degraded semantics is not changed in this MT without an explicit spec/operator decision.
Touched docs/comments accurately describe Ok envelopes versus transport failures.

handoff.summary: Envelope-wrapped remaining Facial review commands with durable HTTP-200 outcome envelopes after request context is established, while preserving pre-context transport failures and D15b export degraded semantics.
implementation_summary: Changed session, claim, decision, status, and montage API routes to return the shared Facial command outcome envelope shape used by export for succeeded, degraded, blocked, and error outcomes.
Added stable non-success error codes, recovery hints, durable command receipts, and receipt readback coverage for post-context non-export command failures.
Kept missing actor, invalid artifact refs, invalid model-operation context, and unknown session batch IDs on the transport-error path before command-envelope wrapping.
Hardened the frontend parser so non-success envelopes require durable receipts, stable error or degraded reason codes, and nonblank recovery hints; whitespace-only degraded reasons are rejected.
Updated the Facial command drain and status/montage readouts to render non-success statuses honestly without fabricating success or queue/result content.
Updated internal manual/comment text touched by MT-055 to describe HTTP-200 command outcome envelopes versus transport/pre-context failures.

RED: frontend parser unit initially accepted an error envelope without recovery_hint; post-review hardening also rejected whitespace-only degraded_reasons.
